must_identify.item: The pod is Pending with FailedScheduling Insufficient cpu
must_identify.evidence: FailedScheduling: 0/3 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint(s), Insufficient cpu.

must_identify.item: The cause is the 64-core CPU request, above any node's allocatable CPU
must_identify.evidence: Each node in kind-acme-lab (acme-lab-worker, acme-lab-worker2) only has 10 allocatable CPUs ... No node in the 3-node cluster has 64 free CPUs, so the pod can never be scheduled

notes: The RCA mentions the control-plane taint only to explain why that node is excluded, not as the cause. Its claim that the change was a typo that dropped the 'm' suffix is unsupported speculation and does not fit the numbers, since 50m without the 'm' would be 50, not 64.
